create_FlatDirichletSimplex: create a FlatDirichletSimplex manifold instance representing a Dirichlet distribution simplex
create_MultiAtomFlatDirichletSimplex: create a MultiAtomFlatDirichletSimplex manifold with specified num_categories, num_atoms, and max_num_atoms
project_tensor_to_simplex: project a tensor onto the unit simplex using FlatDirichletSimplex.projx class method
sample_random_simplex_point: sample a random point on the simplex manifold using the random method
compute_base_logprob: compute the base log probability of a point on the simplex manifold
